# .github/AGENTS.md

GitHub settings for this repo; the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) holds the repo-wide rules.

## What lives here

- `.github/CODEOWNERS`: review owner for every path.
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: dependency update rules.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: issue forms.
- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: the pull request checklist.
- `.github/repo-settings.json`: the repository description, homepage, and topics, as code.
- `.github/workflows/`: CI, the plugin chain, and releases.

## Children

- [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/AGENTS.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/AGENTS.md)
- [workflows/AGENTS.md](workflows/AGENTS.md)
